'''Acceleration rings''' were 17 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]&ndash;wide devices that were used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] as part of the [[Beltway Transit System]]. The rings were also used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on their [[pilot proving grounds]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
